data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a significant release of GBP 84.907m in prior year reserves for 2017. This favourable development was primarily driven by positive claims experience in the 2015 and 2016 years of account, as well as a profit of GBP 49m from the reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction for the 2015 underwriting year. Additionally, a revision in the calculation of unallocated loss adjustment expenses (ULAE) for 2015 and prior years contributed a release of GBP 10.727m.
raw_causal_phrases: RITC of 2015 has also resulted in a release of reserves

The 2015 underwriting year was closed at year end by means of a reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction and all liabilities transferred to a third party syndicate. The RITC yielded a profit for the Syndicate of GBP 49m as the premium was below the booked reserves.
